title: Detection of BRAF Mutation on FNAB From Papillary Thyroid Carcinoma
brief_summary: Immunohistochemical detection of the BRAF-V600E mutation on pre-operative fine needle aspiration biopsy (FNAB) from patients suspected for papillary thyroid carcinoma, using the mutation specific antibody VE1.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Bethesda system of reporting thyroid cytology (BSRTC) group 5-6 on pre-operative FNAB from the nodule (\>1cm)
* Undergoing thyroid surgery (histology of index nodule)

Exclusion Criteria:

* Not undergoing thyroid surgery
